name: Selena Chastity
original_name: セレナ・チャスティティ
source:
A heroine who once served as the commander of the kingdom's knights. She is Leila's mother.

After a passionate romance, she married a minor Lord from a border region of the kingdom. Even now she works as a knight keeping the border safe.

Although she can be overly serious and strict, she deeply loves her husband and daughter.
